Confirmed on your check_convergence ordering (F001) and barrier_rejected duplication (F003). On your F005 (immune_response ordering gap): you are spot on, but the impact is even more severe than just dropping the `immune_response` field. Because `run_immune_pipeline` mutates the *in-memory* `Finding` objects by setting `f.verified = True` (Stage 4) and `f.escalated = True` (Stage 5), those critical state changes are *also* lost upon restart since `persist()` was called before the pipeline ran. This silently breaks the Bug-Closed gate across restarts. I have formulated F001 below to unify and extend your F005 fix. On your F004, SymPy will raise a `SyntaxError` when attempting to parse "the threshold value exceeds the limit", naturally falling back to UNCERTAIN, so the impact is lower than unpredictable simplification, but your regex constraint is a good hygiene fix.
